steps.title: Make loop generations atomic
steps.prompt_exact: The renderer now completes the normal desktop and mobile checks, but rapid terminal-state verification exposed a narrower release race: the run passes when debug logging adds delays, yet at normal speed the sequence failure screen → RE-INITIALIZE → success screen can still leave Runtime.evaluate blocked for 8 seconds. The current isLoopRunning boolean plus one rafId cannot distinguish loop generations. A stale callback from the old run can execute after restart, see the new boolean as true, and create a second requestAnimationFrame chain. Replace that lifecycle with a monotonic generation token captured by every scheduled callback: stopping, pausing, or ending must invalidate the old generation and cancel its frame; a callback may update or schedule its successor only when its captured token is still current; restart must create exactly one fresh generation after state reset. Clear held keyboard/touch input on lifecycle transitions too. Stress the terminal/restart path repeatedly without relying on added delays, while preserving the complete Hull Breach mission, scorecard, input modes, mobile layout, and offline single-file design.
